model: V2 multi-collateral (isolated per-collateral systems, shared vUSD) with user-set per-vault interest rates
note: V2 upgrade (user-set interest rates) requires REDEPLOY — the collateral-agnostic VaultManager gained interest storage/params, so the live V1 contracts below are superseded. Run script/DeployVulcra.s.sol (broadcast gated behind PRIVATE_KEY); fill shared.VUSD + each collateral's PriceOracle/VaultManager/VulcraZap after broadcast. Collateral tokens + registry are resolved on-chain via FlareContractRegistry.

abiChanges.openVault: openVault(uint256 collateral, uint256 mint, uint256 annualInterestRateBps, address prevHint, address nextHint) — NEW 3rd param annualInterestRateBps in [minInterestRateBps,maxInterestRateBps]
abiChanges.openVaultFor: openVaultFor(address owner, uint256 collateral, uint256 mint, uint256 annualInterestRateBps, address debtRecipient, address prevHint, address nextHint)
abiChanges.openVaultAndForward: VulcraZap: openVaultAndForward(uint256 collateral, uint256 mint, uint256 annualInterestRateBps, address vusdDestination, address prevHint, address nextHint)
abiChanges.adjustInterestRate: adjustInterestRate(uint256 newAnnualInterestRateBps, address prevHint, address nextHint) — NEW
abiChanges.getVault: getVault(owner) -> (collateral, debt, active) — debt is now the ENTIRE current debt incl accrued interest
abiChanges.newViews: getTroveEntireDebt(owner), annualInterestRateBpsOf(owner), getEntireSystemDebt(), pendingAggInterest(), mintInterest() [permissionless settle], lowestRateVault()/highestRateVault()/redemptionQueueHead()
abiChanges.redemption: redeem() now draws from LOWEST interest-rate vaults first (was lowest-CR). Liquidation is unchanged: by CR<MCR (per-vault, against entire debt).
abiChanges.sortedList: keyed by annual interest rate ascending; deprecated aliases riskiestVault()/safestVault()/nominalCr() now return rate-based ends.

deprecated_v1_fee_only.note: Live V1 (one-time fee, NO interest) multi-collateral deployment; superseded by V2 above.
